# たら・ば・と・なら — the conditional quartet

**[たら (conditional)](<../grammar/たら.md#conditional>)**
:   The all-round conditional for one specific case and its outcome — and the safe choice before a request or command: 雨が降ったら、中止しましょう。When unsure, pick たら.

**[ば (conditional)](<../grammar/ば.md#conditional>)**
:   Frames the condition as what enables the result — general truths, advice, wishes: 安ければ買います。Awkward before commands unless the condition is a state.

**[と (conditional)](<../grammar/と.md#conditional>)**
:   For automatic, reliable results — X happens and Y always follows: このボタンを押すと、ドアが開きます。Never before a request, command, suggestion, or invitation.

**[なら (conditional)](<../grammar/なら.md>)**
:   Takes up what was just said or assumed — 'if that's the case': 京都に行くなら、秋がいいですよ。Unique here: the advised action can come BEFORE the condition is met.
